title: Epic: Structured Logging System for Dashboard
description: Replace 947 console statements with production-ready structured logging using pino, including performance tracking, request context, and real-time log viewer
close_reason: Epic container - work via child tasks jat-vut.1 through jat-vut.11

title: Set up pino logger infrastructure
description: Install pino and pino-pretty dependencies, create base logger configuration in src/lib/utils/logger.ts with child loggers for api, database, tasks, agents, and websocket contexts. Configure browser-safe logging and dev vs production settings

title: Build dashboard log viewer UI
description: Create /logs route with real-time log viewer. Include SSE subscription for live updates, filters by level and context, search functionality, and formatted display of log entries with metadata. Development-only feature

title: Complete migration of remaining components
description: Migrate remaining ~100 console statements in utility files and lower-priority components. Ensure consistent logging patterns across codebase. Update documentation for logging conventions

title: Create log levels configuration
description: Define log levels strategy in src/lib/config/logConfig.ts with debug, info, warn, error, and fatal categories. Map specific events to appropriate levels (component lifecycle, API calls, errors). Set up environment-specific log levels

title: Implement browser console integration
description: Create browserLogger.ts utility that maintains browser console output in development while adding structure. Include debug toggles via localStorage, formatted group logging, and integration with error reporting services
close_reason: Implemented browser console integration with localStorage persistence and structured logging

title: Add request context tracking
description: Implement request ID generation and request-scoped loggers in src/hooks.server.ts. Track request path, method, duration, and status. Create child loggers with requestId for tracing across the request lifecycle

title: Build performance tracking utilities
description: Create performance.ts with trackApiPerformance function to measure and log API endpoint durations. Alert on slow requests (>1000ms). Include metadata like count and error states in performance logs

title: Migrate API endpoints to structured logging
description: Replace ~600 console statements in /api routes with structured logging. Focus on high-traffic endpoints like /api/agents, /api/tasks, /api/work. Use apiLogger with appropriate log levels and contextual metadata

title: Migrate high-traffic components to structured logging
description: Replace console statements in critical components: SessionCard, TaskTable, AgentCard (~200 statements). Create component-scoped loggers with context. Focus on state changes, errors, and lifecycle events

title: Configure production logging settings
description: Create logger.prod.ts with production configuration including log level management per environment, sensitive data redaction (passwords, tokens), and request sampling for high-volume endpoints. Set up log rotation if using file storage

title: Implement log aggregation storage
description: Choose and implement log storage: Local file storage with rotation, database persistence, or external service (Logtail). Create appropriate utilities for chosen method. Include log retention policies
